headline: Weathered Expanse Bleeds Heaviest; Stonecradle Flares Anew
war_summary: Three hours past our last edition, the Weathered Expanse has become the war's costliest ledger, its five-to-four Warden-Colonial split holding while losses on both sides now run past seven hundred an hour and nineteen base actions stand in the day's count, Crow's Nest and Frostmarch busiest among them. Stonecradle, six posts Colonial against two Warden and one demolished, flared afresh with fighting logged at the very hour of filing, The Reach and World's End seeing the heaviest traffic. In the Linn of Mercy, whence the Warden flag vanished earlier in the day, one Colonial post now lies in ruins while the remaining ten hold under fire, Lathair contested thirteen times. The Stlican Shelf, still at our previous report, has re-ignited around Thornhold and Fort Hoarfrost, posts changing hands as the toll mounts on its five-to-four map. Callahans Passage grinds on under Warden colors with casualties accelerating hourly, while the Dead Lands have gone still again after Callahan's Gate returned to Colonial keeping. The Nevish Line cooled after heavy losses in the day's tally, and Mooring County, despite eight base actions in its ledger, has been quiet since before dawn. Day 311 stands with no victor declared and thirty-four victory towns yet the prize.
